basics.name: Azhari Abbas
basics.label: Aerospace Engineer
basics.summary: Aerospace Engineering student at Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University with a focus on Astronautics and Spacecraft Design. Experienced in test and evaluation engineering, product management, and mechanical design with an active U.S. DoD Secret clearance.

work.name: Mitsubishi Power Americas Inc.
work.summary: Analyzed operational data from high-capacity gas turbines to support product life cycle management and strategy development.
highlights: Coordinated communication between engineering, sales, and program managers across prioritization and production cycles.

work.name: Northrop Grumman Corporation
work.summary: Active U.S. Department of Defense Secret/SAP clearance. Conducted testing of hydraulic, environmental control, electrical, and fuel systems.
highlights: Authored Acceptance Test Procedures to ensure system safety and compliance.
Enhanced augmented reality tools to guide technicians during system testing.

work.name: Docking Robotics LLC
work.summary: Designed and integrated hardware for autonomous ground vehicles.
highlights: Designed and integrated encoder mounting hardware for an autonomous ground vehicle.
Collaborated with vendors to resolve instrumentation and measurement system challenges.

volunteer.summary: Serve on a district-level advisory committee supporting technology integration, STEM initiatives, and educational innovation.
highlights: Provide student and community perspectives on emerging technologies, cybersecurity awareness, and digital equity in K–12 education.

volunteer.organization: J.P. Taravella High School Special Olympics
volunteer.summary: Supported Special Olympics events and student-athlete activities through event coordination and on-site assistance.
highlights: Assisted coaches and staff to ensure inclusive, safe, and engaging athletic experiences.

projects.name: AI-Driven Collision Avoidance for Crowded Orbital Environments
projects.summary: Investigated AI-based methods for predicting and preventing satellite collisions in low Earth orbit using Bayesian RNNs and Graph Neural Networks.
highlights: Reviewed conjunction screening and autonomous maneuver planning.
Outlined hybrid AI–physics modeling for multi-agent coordination.

projects.name: Development of a 6DOF Flight Dynamics Model for the Airbus A320
projects.summary: Developed a six degrees of freedom flight dynamics model using MATLAB to simulate translational and rotational aircraft motion.
highlights: Integrated aerodynamic force and moment models.
